html-creator.name: Meridian · pilot control room
html-creator.description: A polished operating dashboard with explicit fictional data, release gates and an action list.
html-creator.prompt: Create an elegant, responsive one-page pilot control room for fictional Meridian Robotics project M-FR-26. Clearly label every view FICTIONAL DEMO DATA. Snapshot September 8, 2026. Use an ink-navy, warm-white and teal palette; strong typography; a timeline and compact tables. KPI cards: 4 robots, 57/60 workshop missions, EUR 48,000 pilot contract, EUR 12,000 deposit received. Show EUR 36,000 as acceptance-dependent, not received. September 21 pilot is CONDITIONAL: aisle plan Elise Sep 11, map fix Sofia Sep 12, handover Alex Sep 15, 200-scenario QA Marcus Sep 16, go/no-go Priya Sep 17. Add an amber Dock C controlled-stop note, no injuries/damage, fix still in review. Include a working filter for Open / Done tasks with the aisle plan initially open. Do not invent completion, exchange rates or live data. No external fonts/images/requests; build charts with CSS or inline SVG. Buttons are local demo interactions, not purchases or emails.
html-creator.next_step: Press Generate, then inspect the local preview. Facts are scripted fictional input; no live data is fetched.

Warm limestone, deep green and copper accents. Hero: A quieter base for your next working visit. Three room cards with illustrative EUR 180, 210 and 250 nightly rates, two-night business itinerary, breakfast and meeting-room sections, an FAQ, and a room-comparison interaction. Use abstract architectural CSS shapes instead of remote images. All offers and testimonials are explicitly invented demo copy. Contact stays hotel@atelierquay.example. Do not create a real booking, payment form, map or external request.
html-creator.next_step: Press Generate. The hotel is fictional, with no real reservation or payment flow.
